startup.fixDev:
Fix (dev):
- Close Electron
- Run: npm run rebuild:electron
- Then: npm run electron:dev
startup.fixProd:
Fix (prod):
- Reinstall the app (native dependencies are bundled per Electron version)
startup.viteDevServerMissing: VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL is missing in dev mode. Refusing to load dist/index.html.

schemaRecovery.title: Starverse database reset required
schemaRecovery.message: The database schema does not match this version of Starverse.
schemaRecovery.detail:
Existing data cannot be migrated automatically. If you choose "Back up and reset", Starverse moves the current database into a backup folder and creates a new, empty database.

Moved to the backup and not available afterwards: everything stored in the database, including conversations and their history, and OpenAI-compatible providers with their API keys.
Kept: app settings and the API keys of built-in providers.

Backup folder:
{backupRoot}
schemaRecovery.successMessage: The database was backed up and reset.

rendererRecovery.title: Starverse window problem
rendererRecovery.crashed: The app window stopped working unexpectedly. The failure has been logged.
rendererRecovery.loadFailed: The app window failed to load. The failure has been logged.
rendererRecovery.loopWarning: The window has failed repeatedly. Reloading is disabled; restart or close the app.

quitWithActiveWork.title: Work is still running
quitWithActiveWork.message: Starverse is still running work in the background.
quitWithActiveWork.detail: Quitting now will interrupt it. Unfinished generations, file processing or plugin tasks may be lost.

startupFailure.title: Starverse startup failed
startupFailure.integrity: Starverse could not confirm that its database is intact, so startup was stopped to protect your existing data.
startupFailure.io: Starverse could not read or write its database because of a storage error, such as a full or disconnected disk. Startup was stopped to protect your existing data.
startupFailure.access: Starverse is not allowed to open its database, or the file is read-only. Startup was stopped to protect your existing data.
startupFailure.busy: Another program is using the database. Startup was stopped to protect your existing data. Close other copies of Starverse and try again.
startupFailure.other: Starverse could not start. Startup was stopped to protect your existing data.
startupFailure.preserved: The database was not repaired, recreated, migrated or deleted. Back up the database file before troubleshooting.
